name: Actor-count consistency
observable_dimension: Number of distinct intended actors visible or tracked over time
measurement_method: Segmentation/tracking consensus with reflection suppression and human review at ambiguous intervals
unit: proportion of frames and event checkpoints with correct count
threshold_policy: Calibrate separately for realistic and stylized content; any duplicate during a hard actor-count lock is a critical failure
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Reflections, silhouettes, occlusion, crowds, and fused bodies
human_calibration_requirement: Required for full occlusion, mirrors, stylized effects, and disagreements

name: Identity continuity
observable_dimension: Persistence of face, hair, costume, body proportions, and nonfacial signature
measurement_method: Fuse face/body/costume embeddings, color/material descriptors, track continuity, and human identity verdicts
threshold_policy: Thresholds must be learned from same-character positive pairs and intentionally different negative pairs
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Profile view, blur, masks, anime deformation, lighting, and occlusion
human_calibration_requirement: Required whenever component metrics disagree or identity is plot-critical

name: Role-assignment accuracy
observable_dimension: Correct initiator, target, holder, speaker, attacker, and defender assignment
measurement_method: Compare extracted event graph roles with canonical role edges at event checkpoints
threshold_policy: Critical role swaps fail regardless of aggregate score
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Fast contact, similar actors, off-screen action, and ambiguous pronouns
human_calibration_requirement: Required for critical action and dialogue roles

name: Object-count persistence
observable_dimension: Object number across frames, occlusions, cuts, and reflections
measurement_method: Class-aware segmentation/tracking with state-ledger checkpoints
threshold_policy: Zero tolerance for hard-locked product/prop counts; domain-specific tolerance otherwise
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Small objects, reflections, smoke, motion blur
human_calibration_requirement: Review every count change not authorized by an event

name: Object-state transition agreement
observable_dimension: Open/closed, intact/damaged, held/released, wet/dry, on/off, and other state transitions
measurement_method: State classifier or VLM questions anchored to precondition and postcondition frames, plus human adjudication
threshold_policy: Any state change without a causal event is a failure under a hard state lock
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Subtle states, stylization, hidden changes
human_calibration_requirement: Required for product demos and narrative-critical states

name: Reappearance-position error
observable_dimension: Spatial continuity through full occlusion
measurement_method: Predict hidden path from pre-occlusion velocity/trajectory or supplied control track; compare reappearance centroid in normalized screen/world coordinates
unit: normalized frame diagonal or world units
threshold_policy: Provider/task-specific distribution; hard-region violation always fails
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Camera cuts, nonrigid motion, long hidden intervals
human_calibration_requirement: Review when camera or edit transforms are uncertain

name: Occlusion continuity score
observable_dimension: Identity, count, state, pose family, trajectory, and allowed-change agreement across an occlusion interval
measurement_method: Weighted contract checks at pre-entry, hidden interval proxies, and first stable reappearance frame
threshold_policy: No universal threshold; critical hard locks are conjunctive
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: No observable hidden path; evaluator may infer incorrectly
human_calibration_requirement: Required for complete occlusion unless a trusted control track exists

name: Visibility-bridge coverage
observable_dimension: Fraction of hidden interval with a tracked silhouette, mask, shadow, bubble trail, limb, or control signal
measurement_method: Framewise bridge presence and track continuity
threshold_policy: Treat as an input/control diagnostic, not proof of output correctness
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Bridge can attach to the wrong actor
human_calibration_requirement: Review attachment identity on multi-actor scenes

name: Spatial-relation accuracy
observable_dimension: Left/right, front/behind, above/below, near/far, containment, and depth relations
measurement_method: Extract relations per beat in declared coordinate frame and compare with canonical transitions
threshold_policy: Critical relation hard locks fail conjunctively
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Camera-relative ambiguity and close overlap
human_calibration_requirement: Required after cuts/orbits and for ambiguous depth

name: Screen-direction consistency
observable_dimension: Sign and lane of actor motion in screen coordinates
measurement_method: Track actor centroid/pose root and camera transform; compare signed displacement with score
unit: signed direction accuracy and reversal count
threshold_policy: No unauthorized sign reversal within a shot; cross-shot rules depend on declared axis policy
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Orbiting camera, zoom, cuts, and perspective
human_calibration_requirement: Review if camera transform cannot be recovered

name: Unauthorized axis crossing count
observable_dimension: Actor or camera crossing the declared axis of action
measurement_method: Estimate shot geometry and screen-side ordering across checkpoints
threshold_policy: Zero for no-axis-cross hard locks
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Uncertain world geometry from monocular video
human_calibration_requirement: Human review for deliberate reverse angles

name: Depth-order accuracy
observable_dimension: Correct front/behind ordering and occlusion ownership
measurement_method: Depth estimation plus segmentation overlap ordering and human adjudication
threshold_policy: Calibrate by domain; exact metric is unreliable under stylization
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Transparent materials, flat anime art, reflections
human_calibration_requirement: Required in stylized or transparent scenes

name: Event-graph agreement
observable_dimension: Presence and role assignment of requested events and dependencies
measurement_method: Extract event graph from output; compare nodes and typed edges with canonical graph
threshold_policy: Critical events and dependencies are conjunctive; noncritical events can use weighted score
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Fast or visually implied events may be missed by VLM
human_calibration_requirement: Human calibration on critical intervals

name: Temporal event error
observable_dimension: Difference between expected and observed event onset/apex/end
measurement_method: Frame- or time-indexed event detection with uncertainty intervals
unit: milliseconds, frames, or normalized clip duration
threshold_policy: Provider/task-specific tolerance; order inversions always fail
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Ambiguous onset, motion blur, low frame rate
human_calibration_requirement: Required for causally linked events and audio sync

name: Causal-edge accuracy
observable_dimension: Whether consequences follow the correct initiator/cause
measurement_method: Question-answer or event-graph adjudication using explicit cause, target, consequence, and reaction edges
threshold_policy: All critical causal edges must pass
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Coincident events can appear causal
human_calibration_requirement: Human review for ambiguous contact/effects

name: Reaction-latency error
observable_dimension: Delay from cause/contact/near-contact to target reaction
measurement_method: Compare detected cause apex and reaction onset
threshold_policy: Calibrate to style; negative latency is a hard failure unless anticipation is authored
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Subtle anticipation and editing conventions
human_calibration_requirement: Review authored anticipation and anime holds

name: Contact-distance error
observable_dimension: Distance or overlap at intended contact/near-contact frame
measurement_method: Pose/segmentation keypoints, depth proxy, and projected overlap classified by contact type
unit: pixels normalized by body size; depth proxy where available
threshold_policy: Type-specific: physical contact, staged near-contact, camera-cheated contact, grasp, or surface contact
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Monocular depth and hidden limbs
human_calibration_requirement: Required for safety-critical and ambiguous contact

name: Penetration duration
observable_dimension: Duration of impossible body/body, body/object, or limb/surface intersection
measurement_method: Segmentation/pose/depth overlap persistence with topology rules
threshold_policy: Zero beyond allowed stylized smear window
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Occlusion can resemble penetration; pose models fail on anime
human_calibration_requirement: Required for stylized or obscured contact

name: Foot-slip distance
observable_dimension: Support-foot movement while intended planted
measurement_method: Optical flow and point tracking at foot contact, compensated for camera motion
unit: pixels/body-height or world units per support interval
threshold_policy: Calibrate by shot scale and style; flag nonzero drift beyond tracking uncertainty
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Blur, floor reflections, occlusion, low resolution
human_calibration_requirement: Review when confidence interval overlaps threshold

name: Support plausibility
observable_dimension: Base of support, contact state, center-of-mass projection, takeoff, landing, and settle
measurement_method: Pose/track-derived support phases plus human biomechanics review
threshold_policy: No universal physical threshold for stylized content; preserve causal skeleton and authored support phases
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: 2D pose cannot recover true 3D balance
human_calibration_requirement: Human review required for acrobatics and anime

name: Momentum-continuity proxy
observable_dimension: Whether velocity and direction change are causally supported
measurement_method: Track body/object centroids, estimate camera-compensated velocity, and flag unexplained discontinuities
threshold_policy: Provider/task-specific; use as diagnostic, not literal mass-conservation proof
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Monocular scale, cuts, speed ramps, stylization
human_calibration_requirement: Human review for edits and anime time suspension

name: Effect-origin error
observable_dimension: Distance between causal contact/displacement point and splash/debris/flash/smoke origin
measurement_method: Segment effect onset and compare centroid with causal event target point
threshold_policy: Calibrate by effect spread; origin outside allowed region fails
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Diffuse effects and obscured contact
human_calibration_requirement: Review large stylized effects

name: Effect-decay error
observable_dimension: Effect persistence relative to authored onset, peak, decay, and end
measurement_method: Temporal segmentation of effect opacity/area with expected envelope
threshold_policy: Task-specific; any effect before cause is a hard causal failure
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Blended particles and camera exposure changes
human_calibration_requirement: Review when effect boundaries are subjective

name: Material-state consistency
observable_dimension: Water level/topology, wetness, cloth attachment, hair continuity, debris count, and other material state
measurement_method: Material-specific segmentation/state questions at checkpoints
unit: state accuracy and illegal transition count
threshold_policy: Hard locks conjunctive; otherwise domain-calibrated
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Transparent/reflective materials and stylization
human_calibration_requirement: Required for product and fluid-critical scenes

name: Camera-motion agreement
observable_dimension: Pan, tilt, roll, translation, orbit, zoom/lens, and shake versus canonical camera track
measurement_method: Estimate homography/flow/background motion and compare with declared camera components
threshold_policy: Calibrate per shot; distinguish optical zoom from dolly when observable
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Parallax, moving backgrounds, low texture, cuts
human_calibration_requirement: Human review for complex parallax and virtual cameras

name: Camera/actor entanglement ratio
observable_dimension: Unintended covariance between requested camera motion and actor/world displacement
measurement_method: Decompose background, camera, and actor flow; compare intended independent tracks
threshold_policy: Research metric requiring calibration; use primarily for A/B comparisons
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Nonrigid backgrounds, handheld footage, full-frame effects
human_calibration_requirement: Review all high-severity flags

name: Edit/graphic-discontinuity classification
observable_dimension: Correct distinction among cut, flash, smear, blur, wipe, hold, and world-state change
measurement_method: Shot detector plus effect classifier plus identity/state checks before/after interval
threshold_policy: Any graphic-only interval causing unauthorized state reset fails
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: One-frame effects, black frames, stylized cuts
human_calibration_requirement: Human review required for one-frame ambiguity

name: Anatomy-recovery latency
observable_dimension: Time from permitted deformation end to restored anatomy and identity
measurement_method: Pose/silhouette/anatomy checks on required recovery frame and following frames
threshold_policy: Must recover by contract deadline; stylized deformation window excluded
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Pose detectors fail on deliberate smears
human_calibration_requirement: Human animation review required

name: Lip-sync offset
observable_dimension: Temporal alignment of visible speech articulation and audio
measurement_method: Audio-visual speech model plus phoneme/mouth-event alignment
threshold_policy: Calibrate language, frame rate, and speaking style; report confidence interval
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Profile view, beard/mask, stylized mouths, singing
human_calibration_requirement: Human review for low-confidence or creative timing

name: Audio-event alignment
observable_dimension: Timing and semantic agreement of impacts, splashes, breaths, music accents, and environmental sounds
measurement_method: Detect audio events and visual events; compare typed anchors and onset offsets
threshold_policy: Separate semantic mismatch from temporal mismatch
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Overlapping sounds and off-screen sources
human_calibration_requirement: Human review for ambiguous sources

name: Human action readability
observable_dimension: Whether intended actors, action, cause, target, and outcome are understandable
measurement_method: Blinded human rating with forced-choice event/role questions and confidence
threshold_policy: Pre-register acceptance thresholds per use case
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Rater expertise, cultural conventions, fatigue
human_calibration_requirement: At least two calibrated raters for critical scenes

name: Evaluator disagreement
observable_dimension: Conflict across semantic, measurement, and human lanes
measurement_method: Preserve lane verdicts and calculate pairwise/overall agreement
unit: Krippendorff alpha, Cohen kappa, conflict count
threshold_policy: Do not collapse disagreement into a single confident score
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Shared model biases and nonindependent tools
human_calibration_requirement: Adjudication required above pre-registered criticality

name: Observability coverage
observable_dimension: Fraction of hard controls with valid evidence in an appropriate lane
measurement_method: Map each canonical control to evidence, evaluator version, interval, and confidence
threshold_policy: All critical hard locks require evidence or explicit unobservable status
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Evaluator gaps and missing raw assets
human_calibration_requirement: Required for any production qualification

name: Control retention after repair
observable_dimension: Preservation of already-passing controls during localized repair
measurement_method: Re-run full verification plan and compare preserved control IDs
threshold_policy: Zero regression on hard locks; bounded tolerance on soft controls
confidence: calibrate per content domain and provider
known_blind_spots: Evaluator drift and stochastic variation
human_calibration_requirement: Human review for visually meaningful regressions
